title: Don't Touch The Mirrors
sources: Original fiction (SCIFI world-rule). Real idea used loosely: mirrors show a doubled view; animals and predators judge group size by what they can see (bluffing by looking bigger). Fiction, never presented as true.

lines.text: On this colony, every house has mirrors on every wall.
I'm Zed. I just landed, and I asked why.
Everyone just stared at the hills.
But I hate mirrors, so I took one down.
The mayor sprinted in, wearing one slipper.
Put it back! Put it back!
So I hung it up again. Upside down.
But then I peeked out of the window.
Tall grey aliens, counting our houses.
so the aliens think we're too big to attack.
My missing mirror left a hole in the count.
Now I sleep in the kitchen, hugging that mirror.
